notes: 'not' is `added`: the clause writes only `הֲ` and `גַם`, and no negative morpheme licenses it; `הֲ` already holds the fronted 'Will'.
'one' is an impersonal subject pronoun realizing the passive verb's person, not rule 17's `added` lexical subject noun.
Both 'of him' expressions go whole to their suffixes under rule 19's suffix-rectum clause, headed on the pronoun.
